messages:
Aisha Khan: Ok team — quick sync on post-launch prioritization. I built a "priority signal" calendar + backlog heatmap. Proposal: reserve 40% capacity for P1/P2 bug queue, 30% for quick UX improvements (<=3d), 30% for experiments/enhancements. Link: https://redwood.app/heatmaps/rl-2024
Matt Li: Nice, can we make the "P1" definition explicit? Last time things drifted.
Claire Romero: P1 = customer-facing correctness/regressions, outage, data loss. P2 = major UX blockers w/ workaround. Agree to 40% for bugs.
Ben O'Neill: Can we protect one "follow-on milestone" slot for enterprise requests (private deploy) — that's where $ signs are.
Aisha Khan: Good call — let's split the 30% enhancements into 20% features + 10% enterprise hotfixes. Also propose weekly 45-min triage + biweekly grooming deep-dive. Who owns triage?
Kai Park: I can own weekly triage for next 6 weeks. Will rotate after.
shipbot: New issue created: T-8472 — streaming regression; severity P1.
Matt Li: T-8472 — assigning to @Claire Romero and @Ben O'Neill. Can we reprioritize sprint if impact >2 customer tickets?
Claire Romero: Yes. Also need to lock down rollouts: any change touching streaming must have canary + telemetry gate. Add to release checklist.
Aisha Khan: Agreed. Action items:
- Kai to publish triage notes (weekly)
- Ben/Claire to estimate T-8472 by EOD tomorrow
- Matt to update sprint board and ramp down low-impact enh

Kai Park: Triage template:
```
- ID: T-xxxx
- severity: P1/P2/P3
- repro steps
- customer impact
- owner
- next action
```

Ben O'Neill: Estimating now — ETA for 2-day patch if no infra work.
Matt Li: I'll reallocate two FE devs to triage flow from tomorrow.
Claire Romero: One note — customer X is asking for enhancements; we'll scope separate RFC for enterprise hotfix vs enhancement billing.
Aisha Khan: Closing: schedule grooming at 11:00am PT tomorrow. @channel please flag any miss. :thumbsup:
